kind: Source-built MACT math utilities; related primary source plus recovered C, not an original object substitute

primary_source.release: Rise of the Triad v1.3 CD source release, December 20 2002

derivations: ROTT FindDistance renamed FindDistance2D, with recovered iy==0 and ix==0 returns after absolute values
ROTT Find_3D_Distance renamed FindDistance3D, body unchanged
ROTT atan2_appx renamed ArcTangentAppx; historical fixed multiply/divide pragmas unchanged; angle scale 2048/8 and mask 2048-1
FindDistance3D_HP recovered as input shifts by5, three named rounded fixed products, high-precision fixed sqrt and output shift by5; original ROTT FixedSqrtHP pragma reused unchanged
Headers copied byte-identically from related primary source, private to this module; no shared SDK header changes

native_profile.scope: Measured successful profile; original historical command line not recovered

discovery.scope: Explicit MACT emulation, discovery lead only, not historical source identity or production input
